versions.changelog:
Added filter to exclude unreleased items from all Stremio addons (TMDB, Torrentio, etc.)

**Features:**
- Filter out items not yet available for home viewing
- 30-day buffer after theatrical release for movies
- No buffer for TV shows (direct home release)
- Applies universally to search results and catalog imports
- Toggle on/off via plugin configuration (enabled by default)

**How it works:**
Movies must be released for at least 30 days (to account for theatrical → digital/physical delay) before appearing in search or catalogs.
